meta.scope: Thailand Batch 1 — Phase 0/1 foundations under locked expanded node definition. National Statistical Office (NSO), population, national accounts, CPI, Bank of Thailand (BOT) institutional core, BOP. Population ~71.5 million.

candidates.title: National Statistical Office of Thailand (NSO) institutional core
candidates.description: Primary national statistical office responsible for censuses, surveys, national accounts coordination, prices, labour, demographic and multi-domain socio-economic statistics. Publishes the Statistical Yearbook and major survey series.
candidates.notes: Foundational institutional node for the Thai statistical system.

candidates.title: Population census and estimates
candidates.description: Official population census and subsequent estimates. Population is approximately 71–72 million; Thailand is an upper-middle-income economy with advanced demographic transition and rising aging.

candidates.title: National Accounts of Thailand (GDP)
candidates.publisher: Office of the National Economic and Social Development Council (NESDC) / NSO related
candidates.description: Official national accounts (GDP by industry and expenditure). Central macro-output series for a diversified upper-middle-income economy with strong tourism, manufacturing and agricultural foundations.
candidates.notes: Primary macroeconomic output node. NESDC is the key national accounts compiler.

candidates.title: Consumer Price Index and inflation statistics
candidates.description: Monthly CPI and inflation rates. Thailand has generally maintained low-to-moderate inflation relative to many peers in recent years.

candidates.title: Bank of Thailand (BOT) institutional and reporting core
candidates.description: Central bank responsible for monetary policy, financial stability, foreign-exchange management and key macro-financial and external statistics. Publishes monetary, banking, exchange-rate, BOP and related series.

candidates.title: Balance of Payments and external accounts
candidates.description: BOP and external-sector statistics. Tourism and goods exports (electronics, vehicles, agriculture) are major credits; the external accounts are a central policy focus.
candidates.notes: External-accounts node with important tourism and manufacturing signatures.

candidates.title: Thailand foundational statistical-system meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from NSO, NESDC and BOT sources
candidates.description: Meta-node binding the NSO institutional core, population, national accounts, CPI, BOT institutional role and BOP into the opening foundation layer for Thai research.
referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
candidates.notes: Opening integrating node for Thai research.
